committee: * Legislative Certificate No. 391-38 (COR) - Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 391-38 (COR), recognizing the dedicated staff of the Santa Rita-Sumai Mayor’s Office and the members of the Santa Rita-Sumai Municipal Planning Council (MPC) for their efforts in organizing and hosting the 1st Annual Santa RitaSumai Papaya Block Party. The presentation is scheduled for Saturday, June 13, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. at the Santa Rita-Sumai Community Center.
